title: Litematica Special Tool
description: A special tool to use with litematica rather than a stick
body:
# Litematica Special Tool

This simple mod adds a tool that looks like Elder Wand for Litematica which is used to manipulate with schematics in your minecraft world

This is my first project so if there are any bugs or mistakes please let me know. I hope you enjoy your special stick :)

_To set the item just type "litematicaspecialtoolmod:litematicaspecialtool" into the toolItem textbox_
